# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — open the business-evidence channel (`AskUserQuestion` in headless) + bound the ASSESS wave
- Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
  - `rfe.create/SKILL.md` Step 0+2 — `--headless` no longer skips Step 2; one `AskUserQuestion` call gathers «redacted», answers are transcribed VERBATIM, and gaps are stated plainly instead of padded. Targets the `rfe_quality`=4 cap (weak WHY) AND `revision_coverage`.
  - `rfe.auto-fix/SKILL.md` dispatch loop — missing-`subagent_type` fallback + bounded `wait-for-wave` (3 no-progress polls → relaunch, 3 more → recover) + wave recovery that writes a valid `-review.md`. Targets the total-artifact-loss cluster (case-007 t1 0.442, case-012 t1 0.385) and `frontmatter_valid`.
  - `rfe.review/prompts/review-agent.md` §4.1 — literal two-scale table (`scores.*` 0-2 vs `score` 0-10), worked assessment-table→frontmatter mapping, all-seven-fields rule, computed `pass`, never hand-write a `---` block. Targets `frontmatter_valid`.
  - `rfe.review/prompts/assess-agent.md` — relaunch without `subagent_type` if `rfe-scorer` is unavailable; emit the score table on the rubric's `X/2` + `**Total** X/10` scale.
  - `rfe.review/SKILL.md` — one **Polling rule** (bounded retries, dead-agent relaunch) + "`-review.md` is the graded artifact"; paid for in bytes by de-duplicating the `NEXT_POLL` sentence (6×). Net **−12B** vs seed.
- Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe:
  - Fitted the reward exactly: 8 booleans × 4/52, `rfe_quality` 3/pt, `revision_quality` 2/pt. `rfe_quality` mean 3.987 holds 3.04 of the 5.4 units of headroom, and EVERY capped-at-4 rationale named the same cause: WHY has no named customers/revenue/competitive evidence. The inputs DO carry that evidence (case-003: 4 accounts, `$4.2M`, 95%/60%) but it reaches the pipeline ONLY as `AskUserQuestion` answers (`config/eval.poc.yaml` `inputs.tools`), and headless skipped the question. Expect WHY 1→2 across rich cases (001-020).
  - Same edit should FIX `revision_coverage` (mean 0.880, worst boolean): with no real evidence the pipeline invented generic segments (a judge called them "fabricated"), inflating WHY to 1/2 → total 9/10 → `pass=true` → `filter_for_revision.py:64` skips → revise wave never runs → the 5 `revision-expected` weak-draft cases fail (021/023/024/025 = 7/15 trials). Those cases' own contexts demand the gap be left visible; honest reporting gives WHY 0 → automatic fail → revise runs → coverage passes.
  - Safe on well-scored cases: 001-020 are untagged, so `revision_coverage` returns `not revised (untagged)` either way, and E1 can only ADD evidence. case-022 already revises 3/3. Every new fallback writes the COMPLETE required frontmatter set (mirroring the seed's `fetch_failed` fallback), so no boolean is traded for quality.
  - `subagent_type: rfe-scorer` does not exist in the eval env (no `.claude/agents/`, no `--agents`) — verified. That single fact explains both the 0.44/0.38 catastrophes (unbounded `wait-for-wave`, `EXIT: -1` at 900s) and all 3 `frontmatter_valid` failures (orchestrator hand-forges artifacts on a 0-10 scale). `rfe.speedrun:105` already had the bounded/self-healing rule for the create barrier; I ported it to auto-fix.
- Building on prior RESULTS: LEDGER/RUNMAP are empty (iteration 1), so I read the SIBLING run `run_20260909_005053`. Its `cand_0002` tried `--batch-file`/`--batch-entry` so `rfe.create` could read `clarifying_context` from batch.yaml — **rejected, val 0.850, Δ −0.040**. Root cause of that failure: `clarifying_context` is NOT in batch.yaml; it only exists as an `AskUserQuestion` answer. My E1 is structurally different — it opens the channel the harness actually uses instead of reading a file that never holds the data. `cand_0001` there was also rejected (0.889, Δ −0.001) with `broke={}`; the gate's own note said the lever is POWER/SIZE, not redesign — hence a multi-cluster batch this round rather than one tweak.
- Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test): reading `clarifying_context` from the batch YAML / passing `--batch-file`+`--batch-entry` into `rfe.create` (run_20260909_005053 cand_0002, val 0.850 Δ −0.040). The data is not there.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the designs already tried): the `right_sized` calibration contradiction — judges repeatedly ding `right_sized: 2/2` while the same run's feasibility review says "needs splitting" (cases 001/004/006). Not attempted this round because `review-agent.md:45` makes `right_sized=1` a trigger for a `split` recommendation, which would pull IDs out of the submit path and endanger `recommendation_consistency` + `pipeline_flow`. Needs its own isolated iteration with the split rule guarded to submit-with-`needs_attention`.
- Plateau signal: n/a for this run (iteration 1). The sibling run went 0.889 → 0.850 on two single-lever prose tweaks, which is why this batch targets 4 distinct clusters that share one root cause rather than one cluster.
- Focus next iteration: (a) if val moved, isolate the `right_sized`-vs-feasibility contradiction alone; (b) if val did NOT move, first check whether `AskUserQuestion` was actually intercepted inside the speedrun-launched create subagent — read a new trajectory for an `AskUserQuestion` tool call. If it never fires there, the evidence channel must instead be opened in `rfe.speedrun` Phase 1 (Mode C / non-headless create), NOT by re-reading batch.yaml.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.906 Δ=+0.009 · fixed={—} · broke={—} · unresolved={case-001-model-signature-verification-at-serving, case-002-autoscaling-support-for-elastic-ray-clus, case-003-experiment-tracking-integration-for-ml-w, case-006-reliable-multi-turn-stateful-tool-callin, case-007-allow-project-and-workbench-environment, case-008-add-in-ability-to-registerdeploy-an-exte, case-009-notebook-image-preview-for-nvidia-rubin, case-011-mlflow-prompt-template-integration-in-ge, case-012-mlflow-observability-bridge-for-rhoai-mo, case-013-update-universal-workbench-image-with-rl, case-014-maintain-rayjobs-via-the-codeflare-sdk, case-016-red-hat-openshift-ai-rhoai-operator-rena, case-017-clone-rename-llama-stack-to-remove-meta, case-018-autogluon-as-a-supported-model-serving-r, case-019-add-mlflow-integration-for-experiment-tr, case-020-mlflow-experiment-tracking-integration-f, case-021-model-registry-version-compare, case-023-align-kfp-sdk-with-pipeline-server, case-025-pipeline-run-diagnostics-bundle-qe} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them). — no task that was passing under the parent regressed: this batch did not clear the gate's threshold, it did not do damage. So the lever is POWER or SIZE, not a redesign — re-measure with more trials in ONE evaluation, or make the effect bigger. Keep the edits that produced the `fixed` tasks above as your starting point; do not rewrite them on this round's numbers.
